purpose: Manufacturer/model-family fault investigation matrix. These are symptom templates and official documentation routes, not OEM-verified alarm-code definitions.

requiredForVerifiedCase: exact machine model and serial range
policy.rule: Do not infer an alarm meaning from a family name or a support portal. Match exact controller/drive and firmware; if the manual is unavailable, keep this as an unverified template.
